notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 - A Hero in Time - Patch 1.0.0 Notes
notes.content:
The team is excited to finally share the emotional climax of Beatrix’s adventure and the fate of Rainbow Island. In the v1.0 update, A Hero in Time, players will explore the deepest passages of the Grey Labyrinth to find the source of the power that threatens Rainbow Island, and the whole of the Far, Far Range. Arm yourselves with new gadgets, vac upgrades, and the buzziest Quantum Drones a Rancher could ask for.

[previewyoutube=dZIiUWODikw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A Hero in Time Features Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Grey Labyrinth’s Core: [/b]Follow Beatrix to the very heart of the mysterious Grey Labyrinth and discover a brand new zone that leads players to Rainbow Island’s Prismacore. Search every nook and cranny of these puzzling ruins in order to uncover the Labyrinth’s buried secrets. Tread carefully, Ranchers. Danger awaits you, as it does every hero, in [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i]’s thrilling finale. 
[*] [b]Quantum Drones For Every Rancher:[/b] Those beloved, buzzing bees from Slime Rancher have returned, but with a Quantum upgrade! An adorable and expressive helper drone, Quantum Drones now have updated capacities to assist players with ranching at the Conservatory and resource collecting out on the range. Strange though, tech like this shouldn’t be possible. Unless…
[*] [b]An Electrifying New Slime:[/b] A speedy and stylish new slime can be found deep in the Grey Labyrinth. These adrenaline junkies can be difficult to corral and will keep even an experienced Rancher on their toes. Keep a close eye on these hyperactive slimes; they love ricocheting off any surface with incredible bursts of energy. 
[*] [b]Stacked Rancher Upgrades and Gadgets:[/b] In this update, players will find new vacpack and player-specific upgrades to navigate and explore the Grey Labyrinth in its entirety, plus a host of new gadgets and gadget variants to assist players in all their exploration and decorating needs. 
[*] [b]Calling All Achievement Hunters:[/b] Patient players can now start earning achievements on Steam. Some special achievements will be earned retroactively, while others will require players to unlock that particular action in game a second time. Now, Ranchers, get hunting!
[/list][h3]Features List[/h3]

[b]A Story Ends and Secrets Are Revealed[/b]
This update takes players into the heart of the Grey Labyrinth – traversing a mysterious terrarium, revealing hidden passages to a sonic secret, and facing a monstrous foe in its final moments. It’s up to you and your new friend Gigi to unveil the secret of the Prismacore and save Rainbow Island. But what of Gigi’s own secrets? Only time will tell… 

[b]Quantum Drones: A Bizzy Rancher’s Best Bud[/b]
A familiar, albeit upgraded, face returns with Quantum Drones. These cute robo-gadgets assist players in all their ranching and resource collecting needs. Their ability to swap between two different modes, Rancher or Explorer, greatly improves this gadget’s usefulness around Rainbow Island. Just make sure to keep these busy bees fueled up with plorts! With all this free time, Ranchers everywhere can explore without a care in the world. [list]
[*] Rancher Mode, when placed on the Conservatory, allows drones to automate slime care, gardening, and clean up by completing programmed tasks. 
[*] Explorer Mode, when placed out in the wilds, tasks drones with harvesting resources across Rainbow Island. Players will have immediate access to these gathered resources via the new Quantum Cloud inventory. 
[/list]After a hard day’s work, Quantum Drones can get a little sleepy. Utilize Drone Stations to charge their batteries and get a little R&R, as well as program and fuel drones with plenty of plorts. Each crafted station comes with its own paired drone.

[b]What’s Next for [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i]?[/b]
Thank you to our incredible community for supporting [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i]’s ongoing development and updates. We have some of the most dedicated, creative, and sweetest players on this side of the Far, Far Range. It can’t be overstated how much your support means to the studio, and how your passion for this wiggly world continues to inspire us. So, Ranchers (new and old!), enjoy the full experience of [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i] and take the leap with Bea into a thrilling finale.

This might leave players wondering: is this the end? Far, far from it, friend! The team is already hard at work on our next update. The community should expect to see continued development and refinement of [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i] including a host of balances, fixes, and quality of life features, as well as new gameplay content. As always, keep an eye out for more info across our social media accounts. But for now, happy ranching!

notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 - Into the Labyrinth - Patch 0.6.0 Notes
notes.content:
Our Gordo-sized update to [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i] finally hits Rainbow Island! Players will be propelled into the Grey Labyrinth with an arsenal of new gadgets and vac upgrades. Explore the cavernous depths, discover brand new species of slimes, encounter the unnatural phenomena of Prisma Disruptions, and join Beatrix as her story continues to unfold. Prepare yourselves, Ranchers!

[previewyoutube=IVDx-_QAtQk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Into the Labyrinth Features Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dive Into the Grey Labyrinth:[/b] Enter the mysterious Grey Labyrinth and begin to unravel the mysteries of Rainbow Island. Players will need to rely on their wits to travel deeper into this massive new area, with only the most curious players rewarded for their keen eyes and thoughtful exploration. Solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and see where [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i]’s story takes our leading lady.
[*] [b]Investigate Prisma Disruptions:[/b] Explore the Labyrinth’s depths and come face to face with the phenomena called Prisma Disruptions. These enigmatic, rainbow shimmers appear throughout the Labyrinth to varying degrees. It’s said Prisma Disruptions affect not only the environment, but resources as well. Players should exercise the utmost caution when approaching this beautiful, yet chaotic and dangerous, phenomena.
[*] [b]Encounter Strange, New Slimes:[/b] Within the Grey Labyrinth are slimes the likes of which have never been seen in all of the Far, Far Range. Be the first to snag these otherworldly (but still wiggly), new friends. But keep in mind that not every slime can be ranched. 
[*] [b]Rancher Upgrades and Gadgets:[/b] This update introduces [b]6[/b] key vacpack and player-specific upgrades in order to enter and safely traverse the Grey Labyrinth. A combined catalogue of [b]18[/b] new gadgets and gadget variants also gives players the tools necessary to improve their ranching flow and exploration, and expands the roster of decorative gadgets for the Conservatory.
[*] [b]Meet Your Mysterious Host:[/b] Beatrix will finally meet who summoned her to Rainbow Island and for what purpose…
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/f8f637f5881ca9e6c584588879663b0095ba6fba.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features List[/h3]

[b]Venture Into the Grey Labyrinth[/b]
This update includes a massive, varied, new zone to explore that effectively doubles the size of the map of [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i] so far. This almost alien, unpredictable environment will test even the most experienced Rancher – so make sure to keep your eyes peeled and thoughtfully explore its winding halls and perplexing expanses.

Exploring the Labyrinth will have you journeying through stone paths carved by steady streams of water and molten lava to sprawling towers among the clouds where slimes bask in a soft haze, seemingly engulfed in a never-ending sense of dreaminess. And within its heart someone patiently waits for you…

[b]Prisma Disruptions[/b]
These kaleidoscopic rainbow energy surges can happen throughout the Grey Labyrinth and warp the environment around them. Some create impossible obstacles, others change the nature of resources they come into contact with. Players should exercise caution when approaching these unstable and mysterious phenomena. One might be able to use the strange gold gates scattered throughout the area. But how?

[b]Labyrinth Map[/b]

This feature will only be available to players while inside the Labyrinth itself. Full access to the map will require players to activate map nodes throughout the area. So get exploring, Ranchers!

With the help of Disruption Detectors, the Labyrinth Map will also help players track Prisma Disruptions similarly to the weather tracking feature.

[*] Filled a small gap in the terrain at the Dig Site
[*] Fixed an issue where container loot could end up trapped behind the environment
[*] Slimes no longer clip into the side of the pond
[*] Prickle Pear and Pomegranite fruits are more easily harvestable like any other food
[*] Stretchy Water Lettuce no more!

[*] The order of items in the Coo-Coo Corner now displays correctly
[*] Tarr mouths no longer become transparent – ravenous rainbows only!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/48d05e9197a55137a63ddebbbdbf81d4afdba1de.jpg[/img]

[b]A Gordo-Sized Thank You[/b]
As 2024 comes to a close, we want to thank our incredible community for your constant support! Your passion and enthusiasm for the world of Slime Rancher is only mirrored by our own. We hope your exploration of the Grey Labyrinth is filled with surprises and utter delight. Make sure to take in the details our team has so carefully crafted.

Despite how massive this update is, know that this update will only take players through a portion of the Labyrinth and the rest of Rainbow Island’s mystery will be unveiled in our next update. We’ll be sure to share more information on what’s to come next and when in 2025. In the meantime, explore the Grey Labyrinth with Beatrix to its fullest! Happy ranching!

For more information on what to expect during [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i]’s Early Access development, check out our [url=https://www.slimerancher.com/faqs/]Official FAQ[/url].

Need some [i]Slime Rancher 2[/i] support? Please visit the official [url=https://slimerancher2.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]Slime Rancher 2 Help Center[/url].

Experiencing a bug? Go ahead and [url=https://slimerancher2.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]submit a ticket[/url] to our team. Be sure to include your platform of choice, a detailed description of the bug you’ve encountered, and any screenshots or video recordings. All this information will help the team identify and reproduce the issue.

notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 - Add to Cart, ProntoMart - Patch 0.5.0 Notes
notes.content:
Get in, Rancher. We’re going shopping at ProntoMart! Our second content update of the year slides in right in time for a summer of fun with a slew of new gadgets, gadget variants, and the much-anticipated return of Slime Toys.

[previewyoutube=it7ArT3ZVNQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Add to Cart, ProntoMart Features Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Spend Your Newbucks at ProntoMart:[/b] This update introduces a brand new shop system to spend all your hard-earned Newbucks. Head over to ProntoMart to shop for anything from blueprints to toys to cozy decorations. Building off the previous update, ProntoMart will help aid players in their adventuring and ranching journeys. And keep a close eye out for the shop’s purrfect friend.
[*] [b]Go Go Gadget Variants:[/b] This update invites players to really make the ranching experience their own, adding your personal aesthetic and play-style with a hefty combination of functional and deco gadgets. Customize your experience on Rainbow Island with a new roster of [b]51[/b] unique gadgets and [b]31[/b] gadget variants. The customization possibilities are endless!
[*] [b]Slime Toys Bouncing Back:[/b] We all know a well-fed slime is a happy slime. But slimes can also get agitated by the stresses of Rainbow Island. (Have you seen those hungry Tarr?) Soothe them with the return of Slime Toys! Players can buy these special toys through the ProntoMart kiosk. We’ve brought back some old favorites and introduced new ones ready to be loved!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/9beda483ff2bd611ee33017ac3da92b1998d169c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features List[/h3]

[b]Welcome to ProntoMart![/b]

notes.content:
The first content update of the year redefines the gadget system in Slime Rancher 2. Get creative and transform Rainbow Island with a new catalog of stylish, surprising, and silly gadgets. Create an aesthetic oasis for your slimes, overhaul your Ranch from corner to corner, or unleash mechanized chaos on the wiggly inhabitants of Rainbow Island. The world is your playground!

[previewyoutube=ZASwLdpu-ho;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Gadgets My Way Features Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Expanded Interaction with Slimes:[/b] The 'Gadgets My Way' update introduces imaginative and lively interactions with slimes. Imagine your slimes lounging on the beach, getting thrilled in homemade pinball machines, or playfully bouncing through fields of colorful pinwheels. This update offers a wide array of thematic settings - from serene to playful - allowing players to create memorable experiences with their slimes on Rainbow Island.
[*] [b]Comprehensive Building System Overhaul:[/b] Experience a transformative building system with key features that include a streamlined Gadget mode HUD, offering a more intuitive building experience, and an innovative collection review system integrated into the updated Slimepedia. This update not only enhances the ease of constructing your dream ranch but also enriches the process of discovering and cataloging your unique slime and gadget collections.
[*] [b]More Gadget Content and Exploration:[/b] Dive into a world of discovery with 36 new gadgets and treasures waiting in hidden nooks and crannies of Rainbow Island. The update invites players to uncover secret treasure pods, unveiling gadgets that enhance the immersive and interactive nature of the game. Explore new areas, unveil mysteries, and enrich your ranching experience with these exciting additions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/9b7b626de97d289a716ac747daeb34d1157c8fd0.png[/img]

[h3]Features List[/h3]

[b]Overhauled Gadgets System[/b]
Gadget placement restrictions have been eliminated and gadgets are no longer destroyed upon pickup. Drop gadgets anywhere you like, but make sure there’s enough space for larger gadgets.

You can now peruse through the gadget inventory without having to return to the fabricator. Easily cycle through your most beloved gadgets with the addition of a favorites bar. Gadget categories have also been updated. 

You may notice that some of the pre-existing placement hotkey controls are different. After months of rigorous testing, we’ve determined this new system is optimized for long-term, optimal navigation. So please excuse the slight learning curve with this update. 

And for all you explorers out there, we’ve dropped several new gadgets in the world for you to discover. Search high and low for these hidden gems, and gather blueprints to craft new gadgets!

notes.title: Come Rain or Slime - Patch 0.3.0 Notes
notes.content:
Get swept up in our newest content update for Slime Rancher 2! All sorts of weather patterns hit Rainbow Island for the very first time. Navigate through heavy rains, thunderstorms, iridescent pollen, and even massive cyclones. As you explore, be on the lookout for some familiar slimes and their favorite snacks!

[previewyoutube=CwRnBbxRkhg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Come Rain or Slime Features Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Weather System:[/b] Slime Rancher 2 now features a dynamic weather system. Players will experience varying degrees of Rain, Wind, Thunderstorms, Pollen, and more across the world. Brave the elements as more severe weather strikes, or take a load off to enjoy the cozy ambiance of milder weather patterns. 
[*] [b]Expanded Original Score:[/b] Each severe weather pattern features a beautiful new melody to accompany your treacherous dash home or daring storm chasing adventure.
[*] [b]Dervish and Tangle Slimes Return:[/b] Riding in on cyclones during windstorms or popping out of the ground through tangles of creeping vines, Dervish and Tangle Slimes return to join Beatrix’s latest adventure. Carefully track severe weather patterns to wrangle these elusive slimes!
[*] [b]Tasty Snacks:[/b] We can’t leave these newly wrangled Tangle and Dervish Slimes hungry! Their favorite foods Prickle Pears, Painted Hens, and Painted Chickadoos also return. Remember: A hungry slime is an unhappy slime, and we don’t want any unhappy slimes…
[*] [b]Slimepedia Makeover:[/b] The Slimepedia has undergone an extensive overhaul to make learning about the world of Slime Rancher a much easier experience. Poke around and enjoy the new beautiful interface. Be sure to check the map for the latest weather!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/19ab874cda2c537e573c20922a4508aa678da9b6.png[/img]

[b]Dynamic Weather System[/b]
A dynamic weather system has been added that can produce a variety of weather patterns in a zone at varying levels of intensity, even combining with others to create turbulent storms across Rainbow Island. Weather patterns can be tracked via the map.

Please note that dynamic weather only begins after two in-game days have passed and in zones that have already been explored. This means that a fresh save file will potentially see weather on day 3 in a zone already visited once before, and existing saves must have two more in-game days pass after receiving the update before weather patterns will form.

[*] [i][b]Thunder,[/b][/i] with varying levels of intensity, culminating in a thunderstorm that can cause lightning bolts to rain down from above, and features a unique musical score. Thunderstorms often occur during rainstorms, but not exclusively.
[*] [i][b]Pollen,[/b][/i] with varying levels of intensity, culminating in the growth of creeping vines in the area, and features a unique musical score.
[*] [i][b]Snow,[/b][/i] which remains exclusive to Powderfall Bluffs, where the unnaturally cold climate can support it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/e28cf8eb524f3c063dd73a862f6676d05e8ce1c4.png[/img]
Slime Rancher 2 Patch 0.2.1 is focused primarily on bug fixes with a bonus new deco gadget. The team is hard at work on future content updates for Slime Rancher 2 so please stay tuned!

[h1]Slime Rancher 2 - Patch 0.2.1[/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[h3]New Frozen Flame deco gadget[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blueprint added to a new Treasure Pod in Powderfall Bluffs
[*] Craftable in the Fabricator
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[h3]World[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted aurora platform colors in Powderfall Bluffs
[*] Adjusted Sun Sap asset size in Powderfall Bluffs
[*] Fixed issues regarding resource node placement in Powderfall Bluffs
[*] Fixed steam FX visual bugs
[*] Added spring water splash SFX variants (smaller splashes)
[*] Resolved flashing issues that take place when entering certain caves (it was the Plortparazzi snappin pics of Bea and we asked them to stop)
[*] Addressed in-world model gaps, missing collisions, and LODs
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Copy and translation typo corrections
[*] Resized Slimepedia text in Russian to match font size in other languages
[*] Fixed font not displaying in Russian on gadget screens
[*] Added shoreline for Powderfall Bluffs on the map
[*] Updated loading screen image to accommodate ultrawide screens (32:9)
[*] Removed extra click SFX on certain options buttons 
[*] Updated in-game privacy policy url
[*] Separated SFX sounds for ‘select’ and ‘change’ actions on Options screens
[/list]
[h3]Slimes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed idle animation errors on certain slimes
[*] Fixed slime parts not connected to the body on certain slimes (yikes)
[*] Fixed Tarrs turning invisible when chomping
[*] Fixed Tarrs not despawning in scenegroups, resulting in high number of Tarrs present in-game overtime
[*] Fixed Cotton Hunter Largos not turning feral when hungry
[*] Fixed Ringtail Largos becoming feral when hungry
[*] Fixed Fire Slime despawning after time is fast-forwarded
 [/list]
[h3]Science[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Hydro Shower cooldown able to reset after picking up item
[*] Corrected newbucks crafting cost on Golden Angler Statue
[*] Fixed Saber Gordo teleporter player interaction bug
[*] Move Location Flags from ‘Decorations’ to ‘Utilities’ category in the Fabricator 
[/list]
[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Eliminated NullReferenceError reports
[*] Changed “harvest resource” VFX to lower photosensitivity discomfort
[*] Remove flash when Ancient Teleporter activation VFX plays
[*] Updated Plort Market logic to refresh after saving game
[/list]


As always, thank you to our vibrant community for your continued support! We hope you’re enjoying the wintery wonders of Powderfall Bluffs and have kicked up a snowball fight or two. We’re currently tinkering away, but be on the lookout for what’s next in Slime Rancher 2.

Stay wiggly!

notes.title: Song of the Sabers - Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
The first major content update for Slime Rancher 2 has arrived! Discover Powderfall Bluffs, a mysterious, glacial island off the coast of Ember Valley. As if it were a giant, icy time capsule, you’ll find a thriving community of prehistoric Saber Slimes and Thundercluck chickens within, as well as strange, auroral anomalies, a treasure trove of new resources, and more!


[previewyoutube=yevHIZWwBL0;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Song of the Sabers Features Overview[/h2]
[h3]Explore a New Biome[/h3] Powderfall Bluffs is a prehistoric frozen island that has mysteriously emerged from the Slime Sea. It’s an icy biome unlike anything ever seen in Slime Rancher, but you’ll need to find it first before enjoying this winter wonderland. Here’s a hint: the entrance to it is located somewhere in Ember Valley…

[h3]Wrangle New Slimes[/h3] This snowy sanctuary is home to Saber Slimes—a ferocious blast from the past! And this update also includes a new, RARE slime, but we don’t want to make it overly easy for you to find it so that’s all the info you’re getting from us…

[h3]Source New Food[/h3] Prehistoric Thundercluck chickens roam among the snowdrifts. They’re scary looking! But they just look like dinner to a Saber Slime.

[h3]Gather New Resources[/h3] Powderfall Bluffs offers many new precious resources from its frigid peaks including impossibly Perfect Snowflakes, rare Sun Sap, and adorable Slime Fossils.

[h3]Build New Gadgets[/h3] Start an icy dust-up anywhere with the Snowball Machine or put other handy gadgets to use like the Hydro Shower, Location Markers, and new Warp Tech.

[h3]Craft Wintery Deco[/h3] Craft a giant snowflake just because you can, or a snow globe that plays music to really set the mood, as well as golden slime and chicken statues and earn the admiration (or at least curiosity) of your fellow ranchers.

[h3]Walk Upon Auroral Anomalies[/h3] Phantom-like flora gleam throughout the landscape and nightfall illuminates bridges that allow you to reach new heights along the icy mountains—but act fast before they vanish with the dawn.

[h3]Snowball Fights[/h3] Slimes love to play in the snow and won’t hesitate to engage in a snowball fight with you and other slimes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/9dfa13185d215238264f70b7b7660b90d62b4ad0.png[/img]

[h2]Features List[/h2]
[h3]Powderfall Bluffs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Real-time snow deformation
[*] Snowball fights with slimes!
[*] Auroral Anomalies
[*] New Research Drones
[*] New Treasure Pods[/list]
[h3]New Slimes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Saber Slime
[*] Saber Gordo
[*] [REDACTED]
[/list]
[h3]New Slime Science Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sun Sap
[*] Perfect Snowflake
[*] Slime Fossil
[/list]
[h3]New (well, technically ancient) Chickens[/h3]
[list]
[*] Thundercluck
[*] Thunder Chickadoo
[/list]
[h3]New Vac Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Power Core Rank 4
[*] Tank Booster Rank 4
[*] Golden Sureshot Rank 1
[*] Golden Sureshot Rank 2
[*] Golden Sureshot Rank 3
[/list]
[h3]New Utility Gadgets[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hydro Shower
[*] Snowball Machine
[*] Location Markers
[*] Snowy Teleporter
[*] Snowy Warp Depot
[*] Powderfall Bluffs Portal
[/list]
[h3]New Deco Gadgets[/h3]
[list]
[*] Golden slime statues
[*] Chicken-themed statues (we do really important work here)
[*] Lots of Powderfall Bluffs scenery deco
[*] Special Powderfall Deco, including a giant snowflake, and an (also giant) musical snowglobe 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/f48e7cf4bed60be17471618002ddf78b2eb1755d.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Additional Treasure Pods added to Conservatory, Ember Valley, and Starlight Strand
[*] In-game analytics added to improve our ability to balance and tune the game. This can be opted out of in settings.
[*] Triple Plort switch door in Starlight Strand now only requires one Plort switch
[*] When loading a save fail, player now has the option to recover by loading the last autosave
[*] Refinery items you haven’t unlocked yet are now hidden
[*] Improved slime and resource interactions with lava
[*] Page indicators on all UIs now clickable
[*] New UI button animations
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replaced outdated visual effects and materials for classic slimes
[*] Minor slime behavior bug fixes 
[*] Fixed keybinding icon display in options
[*] Fixed incorrect or missing icons in the Fabricator
[*] Corrected typos and inconsistencies in localization
[*] Troubleshooted general in-world locations where players would get stuck, or fall through the world
[*] Energy will now drain if Bea continues sprinting after landing
[*] No more hen hens trapped below the coop in gully plot or trapped behind couches
[*] Fixed edge cases that impact performance in the conservatory
[*] Fixed issue where player couldn’t obtain the pink bonsai blueprint
[*] Minor environment asset texture updates
[*] Implemented missing shader quality function
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] An unsupported character may appear instead of an "x" in Russian.
[*] The particle effects toggle has no effect.
[*] Tabby Slimes will sometimes sit idle when they try to steal food.
[*] Tarr sometimes do not despawn properly in unloaded scenes.
[*] The golden angler statue has an incorrect newbucks cost.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/641122e82960d788f5f01ae84713fbb5073ed078.png[/img]

[h2]Beyond the Frozen Horizon[/h2]
Song of the Sabers is our first major content update for Slime Rancher 2 and aims to deliver more of what you know and love about Slime Rancher, with a few surprises along the way.

Following this update, Monomi Park will be developing new features that build upon the core activities and game systems of Slime Rancher, allowing you to experience Rainbow Island in new ways. We’re excited about this set of features that we think will wiggle, jiggle, and shake up the Slime Rancher formula.

Further out, Beatrix’s adventure will finally take her into the massive and mysterious Grey Labyrinth that blocks her progress across the furthest reaches of the island. And though its purpose and history remain unknown, it's clear that the key to unlocking the secrets of Rainbow Island lies beyond its walls. 

For information on what to expect during Slime Rancher 2’s Early Access development, check out our [url=https://www.slimerancher.com/faqs/]Official FAQ[/url].
For Slime Rancher 2 support issues, please visit the official [url=https://slimerancher2.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]Slime Rancher 2 Help Center[/url].

Thank you again for your continued support of Slime Rancher 2. We hope you enjoy more of this strange, beautiful, and wiggly world we’re building for you to explore.

Stay wiggly,
Monomi Park

notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 update has snow, Sabers, and secrets in borealis biome
notes.content:
At its core, Slime Rancher 2 is a cute, colourful, relaxing game, and its stunning visuals and soft soundtrack are what make it all the more immersive when you're sucking up long-eared Cotton slimes or jet-pack jumping across biomes. It's only natural, then, that a new Slime Rancher 2 content update - and new area - should feature the same awe-inspiring visuals you're used to, and Powderfall Bluffs does just that, giving you the perfect pastel escape at the end of a long day.

In the Slime Rancher 2 Song of the Sabers update, you need to find your way to this frosty new Winter Wonderland. Here, stunning secrets await that any fan of the cute and colourful world of Slime Rancher will be in awe of, and it's safe to say it left me literally speechless. While I can't yet tell you how to find this new area, I can tell you a bit more about what awaits you under its melting snowdome.

notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 - Patch 0.1.2 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722074/fa8803b13ec353d0eb116653c30c0d7e16469eda.png[/img]

Slime Rancher 2 Patch 0.1.2 includes bugfixes, and some balance and quality of life changes. It is not a major content patch. We will be providing an update to the Slime Rancher community in the near future that covers what to expect with Slime Rancher 2’s future content updates. Stay tuned!


[h2][b]Slime Rancher 2 - Patch 0.1.2[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New options are available in the Display Settings to adjust gamma and brightness.
[*] Mouse sensitivity range has been increased.
[*] Slowed down reproduction rates of chickens outside of coops, preventing the chicken uprising.
[*] Reduced the animal cull limit in the Conservatory to remove chickens where the uprising has already happened.
[*] Made some adjustments to Cotton Slime hopping that will reduce their tendency to hop out of corrals, especially with food nearby. We’ll be keeping an eye on this one and would appreciate your feedback.
[*] Many deco gadget costs have been adjusted, increasing in Plort cost but reducing in Slime Science material costs.
[*] Adjusted the cost of the Water Tank to allow for it to be crafted earlier in the experience.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Various typos have been corrected, others have been left in intentionally. That’s just how BOb talks, ok?
[*] Names in the Credits have been adjusted and corrected. (sorry!)
[*] Fixed an issue where Beatrix would sometimes fall through the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not increase the rank of certain vac upgrades despite having the necessary upgrade components.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain resources could not be collected after a prolonged game session.
[*] Fixed a bug causing Tarr to be more dangerous than intended.
[/list]
Thank you again for your support in making Slime Rancher 2 a huge success. We are very grateful to our community and excited for the adventure ahead that we will share with you.


Stay wiggly!

notes.title: Slime Rancher 2 Now Available in Early Access
notes.content:
[i]In the distance, there was an island with colors that danced and moved like a dream…[/i]

[h3]Slime Rancher 2 is now available in Early Access![/h3]

Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys to Rainbow Island, a mysterious land brimming with ancient technology, unknown natural resources, and an avalanche of wiggling, jiggling, new slimes to discover in the sequel to the award-winning, smash-hit original that has been enjoyed by over 15 million fans worldwide. 

[previewyoutube=LOI5tz7eZ5A;full][previewyoutube=vVXokd2Bfhw;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Features:[/h3]

[b]Explore a Vibrant New World:[/b] Continue the slime ranching adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys to a mysterious rainbow-hued island.

[b]Discover Wiggly New Slimes:[/b] Collect slimes never seen before on the Far, Far Range, like the bouncy Cotton Slime or the aquatic Angler Slime.

[b]Build a Conservatory on Rainbow Island:[/b] Earn Newbucks from Slime Plorts and collect resources on Rainbow Island to upgrade your Vacpack, build new gadgets, and expand your conservatory.

[b]Lots of Free Updates on the Way: [/b]The world of Slime Rancher 2 is always growing. Expect lots of free content updates as Rainbow Island expands with new worlds to explore, reveals more wiggly, new slimes to wrangle, and exciting, new features are added to change the way you play.


For information on what to expect during Slime Rancher 2’s Early Access development, [url=https://www.slimerancher.com/faqs]check out our Official FAQ.[/url]

For Slime Rancher 2 support issues, please visit the [url=https://slimerancher2.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]official Slime Rancher 2 Help Center.[/url]
